svg.title: Secondary comparison of changes
svg.desc: Secondary comparison of changes. Secondary descriptive comparison of changes in repeated cohorts (percentage points): historical 2008–2015; modern 2016–2024 for progression and 2016–2023 for absence. Each point shows a nominal 95% school-bootstrap interval and a normal school-plus-student diagnostic. The diagnostic has weak precision; the bootstrap omits cross-school student dependence. Estimand and sample differ from the primary result: subtracting points does not attribute causality. Prior selection and parallel trends remain unverified.
